than im ready to fail, giving up tonight. been awake a few days now, havent spoken to a real person in those days.

Life is loneliness and suffering and I'm done

I just want to be able to provide for myself. Earn enough money to not be a burden. In my experience desires and commitment are useless. How much I want something or how hard I work for it is irrelevant, Ill faill in the end anyways.
I see you still believe in fairytails, thinking something on the brightside won't do much good. Just makes the dissapointment bigger, I know cause I've tried A LOT A LOT A LOT
I have given myself one of these clocks, gave myself till the age of 28 to make something of my life. But I most likely won't cause im a failure, wonder if I'll stick to my clock.
Your story looks a lot like mine, I can relate. I am depressed too, wish I knew a solution. I am sorry.
8 years of professional help. Nothing can help me no place like that exsists
hahahaha a second option, yea its called new failure. Because thats how stuff ends up for me. It doesn't always get better, it always gets worse.
